updates.title: Hotel availability re-checked live — new list
updates.description: We re-ran availability for October 2–4, two adults and one child, and published a fresh list. Country Inn & Suites at Harbison is confirmed at $161 per night and is now our top pick. The Hampton Inn Harbison did not come back as available in any search — we have stopped recommending it. Rates come from a live Hotels.com search scoped to those exact dates; it is a partial result set, so a hotel missing from the list is unknown rather than sold out. Confirm the current price before booking.

updates.title: Bracket confirmed — Under 10 Boys Green Division
updates.description: Our bracket is posted and verified. Savannah United 16/17B Blue plays in Under 10 Boys Green Division (8 teams in total, listed in the guide below). Opponents are known; the schedule with times, fields and pairings posts September 26.

updates.title: No stay-to-play policy published — re-checked September 18
updates.description: We checked the official tournament page, the SCUFC host site and the registration portal again on September 18, 2026 and still found no housing requirement or approved-hotel list for the Carolina Cup. Our picks are simply the closest options with confirmed availability — there is no housing portal to book through. We have asked tournament director Tripp Miller to confirm.

updates.title: Online check-in is open — complete it now
updates.description: The accepted team list posted September 14 and all four of our teams are on it. SCUFC's tournament page states that online check-in opened after that, that there is NO on-site check-in, and that teams should start online check-in immediately. This is the one item that cannot be handled at the field. Re-verified September 18, 2026.

updates.title: Game schedule posts September 26 and the page is offline — re-checked September 24
updates.description: Brackets are done; the full schedule is the last piece. It posts September 26, 2026 with game times, fields and the actual pairings. Until then we do not know which of SCUFC's five complexes our teams play at. We check the official page through the day and publish the new schedule here as soon as games appear, then send the updated guide with a departure time for every family.

updates.title: 2026 rules document still not published — re-checked September 18
updates.description: We checked the official tournament content pages again on September 18, 2026 and found no 2026 Carolina Cup rules document. Game length, mercy rule, substitutions and the tiebreaker order all remain unconfirmed. We will not fill these in from another tournament's rulebook. Rules questions can go to Tournament Director Tripp Miller at tripp@scufc.com.

breakPlan.title: Between-Games Rhythm
breakPlan.intro: Saturday is a 9:15 AM and 1:00 PM double, both at Polo Road — about 1 hour 55 minutes between the final whistle and the next report time. Stay on site and treat it as a reset, not a break.

steps.label: Eat immediately
steps.note: Within 30 minutes of the whistle. Pack it — leaving the complex costs you the whole window.

steps.label: Shade + dry kit
steps.note: Change shirt and socks, hat off, water and electrolytes.

steps.label: Quiet sit
steps.note: Sit down properly. Late morning at Polo Road is hotter than the 9:15 kickoff felt.

steps.label: Back for game #805
steps.note: Field 4. Short warm-up only — no chasing a ball for 40 minutes.

food.addr: 9308 Two Notch Rd, Columbia, SC 29223, USA
food.why: Quick noodle bowls, not fried — good between games and easy on the stomach.

food.name: J.R. Cash's Grill and Bar
food.addr: 111 Sparkleberry Crossing Rd #11, Columbia, SC 29229, USA
food.why: Family grill for a sit-down meal when there is time to spare.

food.name: Tacos Nayarit
food.why: Best-reviewed Mexican near the park; quick, cheap, kid-friendly.

foodNote: The gap between Saturday games is about 1h55m, so keep it close and quick: Luca's is 0.3 mi from the gate and Little Pigs is counter service.
